spans.s:
liṅga (BL; SII 1; CII 3, etc.), same as śiva-liṅga; the phallic emblem^1 of Śiva; the emblem connected with the worship of Śiva; generally named after the founder with the suffix īśvara.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210207. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/51.
liṅgoraṇa (IA 11), conjecturally translated as ‘the festival of rams [to be sacrificed] to the liṅgas’.
